title: Graph chart
description: Relationship networks: people, organizations, services or any entities and the links between them. A force-directed layout (Barnes–Hut, in a Web Worker for large graphs) or circular and arc diagrams place the nodes; nodes and edges are drawn on the GPU (WebGPU, WebGL2, WebGL, Canvas2D fallback), so tens of thousands of nodes stay smooth. Hover a node to highlight its neighbors, drag it, toggle groups in the legend, and walk through the graph with the keyboard.

overview.title: Overview
overview.text: GraphChart takes nodes, edges and optional groups. Groups give the colors and the legend, node values size the circles, and edge labels name the relationships.
overview.layouts: Layouts: force (default) with link, many-body, gravity and collision forces and a deterministic seed; circular (grouped, with edges bundled through the center); arc diagram; dag and tree layouts are also available (see Dependency graph and Tree chart). The layouts are exported as pure functions for workers and mini-programs.
overview.gpu: Rendering goes through the same GPU backends as the other charts, with an automatic WebGPU → WebGL2 → WebGL → Canvas2D fallback; the renderer in use is reported by onRendererChange and the data-renderer attribute.
overview.labels: Labels avoid each other: when zoomed out only the most important nodes keep their label, and edge labels appear when zooming in or when an edge is highlighted.

controls.title: Interaction and accessibility
controls.pointer: Drag the background to pan, Ctrl / ⌘ + wheel or pinch to zoom, drag a node to move it (the simulation follows), click to select (Ctrl / ⌘ + click adds), double click the background to fit. The buttons in the corner zoom and fit.
controls.keyboard: Focus the chart and use the arrow keys to move from node to node; Enter selects, + and - zoom, 0 fits, Esc clears. Focused nodes are announced with their group and number of links.
controls.languages: Built-in texts (summary, announcements, tooltip rows, buttons) exist in English, Chinese, Japanese and French and follow the page language; colors follow the light and dark themes.

<script setup lang="ts">
// Air routes between hub cities: a force-directed network, node size from
// the size of the hub, edge width from the weekly flights, colored by region.
import { computed } from "vue";
import { useI18n } from "minerva-design/vue";
import { GraphChart } from "minerva-design/vue/charts";

const CITIES = {
  en: [
    "Beijing",
    "Shanghai",
    "Tokyo",
    "Seoul",
    "Singapore",
    "Dubai",
    "Sydney",
    "London",
    "Paris",
    "Frankfurt",
    "New York",
    "Chicago",
    "Los Angeles",
    "São Paulo",
  ],
  zh: [
    "北京",
    "上海",
    "东京",
    "首尔",
    "新加坡",
    "迪拜",
    "悉尼",
    "伦敦",
    "巴黎",
    "法兰克福",
    "纽约",
    "芝加哥",
    "洛杉矶",
    "圣保罗",
  ],
  ja: [
    "北京",
    "上海",
    "東京",
    "ソウル",
    "シンガポール",
    "ドバイ",
    "シドニー",
    "ロンドン",
    "パリ",
    "フランクフルト",
    "ニューヨーク",
    "シカゴ",
    "ロサンゼルス",
    "サンパウロ",
  ],
  fr: [
    "Pékin",
    "Shanghai",
    "Tokyo",
    "Séoul",
    "Singapour",
    "Dubaï",
    "Sydney",
    "Londres",
    "Paris",
    "Francfort",
    "New York",
    "Chicago",
    "Los Angeles",
    "São Paulo",
  ],
};
const REGIONS = {
  en: ["Asia", "Oceania", "Europe", "Americas"],
  zh: ["亚洲", "大洋洲", "欧洲", "美洲"],
  ja: ["アジア", "オセアニア", "ヨーロッパ", "南北アメリカ"],
  fr: ["Asie", "Océanie", "Europe", "Amériques"],
};
// region (index in REGIONS) and size of the hub, in the order of CITIES
const HUBS = [
  [0, 8],
  [0, 9],
  [0, 9],
  [0, 6],
  [0, 8],
  [0, 7],
  [1, 5],
  [2, 9],
  [2, 8],
  [2, 7],
  [3, 9],
  [3, 6],
  [3, 7],
  [3, 5],
];
// weekly flights between two cities (indexes in CITIES)
const ROUTES = [
  [0, 1, 120],
  [0, 2, 40],
  [1, 2, 55],
  [2, 3, 60],
  [1, 3, 35],
  [1, 4, 30],
  [4, 6, 28],
  [2, 6, 14],
  [4, 5, 25],
  [5, 7, 42],
  [5, 8, 21],
  [5, 9, 20],
  [7, 8, 70],
  [7, 9, 50],
  [8, 9, 35],
  [7, 10, 80],
  [8, 10, 40],
  [9, 11, 14],
  [10, 11, 90],
  [10, 12, 85],
  [11, 12, 60],
  [12, 2, 28],
  [12, 6, 14],
  [10, 13, 21],
  [12, 1, 18],
  [0, 9, 12],
  [4, 7, 21],
];

const { language } = useI18n();
const nodes = computed(() => {
  const names = CITIES[language.value] ?? CITIES.en;
  return HUBS.map(([region, size], i) => ({
    id: `c${i}`,
    label: names[i],
    group: `r${region}`,
    value: size,
  }));
});
const groups = computed(() =>
  (REGIONS[language.value] ?? REGIONS.en).map((name, i) => ({
    id: `r${i}`,
    name,
  })),
);
const edges = ROUTES.map(([a, b, flights]) => ({
  source: `c${a}`,
  target: `c${b}`,
  value: flights,
}));
</script>

<template>
  <GraphChart
    :nodes="nodes"
    :edges="edges"
    :groups="groups"
    :node-size="[10, 34]"
    :height="440"
  />
</template>

overview.title: Overview
overview.text: GraphChart takes nodes, edges and optional groups. Groups give the colors and the legend, node values size the circles, and edge labels name the relationships.
overview.layouts: Layouts: force (default) with link, many-body, gravity and collision forces and a deterministic seed; circular (grouped, with edges bundled through the center); arc diagram; dag and tree layouts are also available (see Dependency graph and Tree chart). The layouts are exported as pure functions for workers and mini-programs.
overview.gpu: Rendering goes through the same GPU backends as the other charts, with an automatic WebGPU → WebGL2 → WebGL → Canvas2D fallback; the renderer in use is reported by onRendererChange and the data-renderer attribute.
overview.labels: Labels avoid each other: when zoomed out only the most important nodes keep their label, and edge labels appear when zooming in or when an edge is highlighted.

controls.title: Interaction and accessibility
controls.pointer: Drag the background to pan, Ctrl / ⌘ + wheel or pinch to zoom, drag a node to move it (the simulation follows), click to select (Ctrl / ⌘ + click adds), double click the background to fit. The buttons in the corner zoom and fit.
controls.keyboard: Focus the chart and use the arrow keys to move from node to node; Enter selects, + and - zoom, 0 fits, Esc clears. Focused nodes are announced with their group and number of links.
controls.languages: Built-in texts (summary, announcements, tooltip rows, buttons) exist in English, Chinese, Japanese and French and follow the page language; colors follow the light and dark themes.

characters.title: Character relationships
characters.description: Characters of Romance of the Three Kingdoms, colored by faction, sized by importance, with the relationship on every edge. Hover a character to see its circle, hover an edge to read the relationship, click to select, and toggle the factions in the legend.

large-network.title: 10,000 nodes on the GPU
large-network.description: Forty generated communities: 10,000 nodes and about 20,000 links. The simulation runs in a Web Worker (worker="auto" above 2,000 nodes) while the GPU draws every frame; the view follows the layout until you pan or zoom.

circular.title: Circular layout
circular.description: Calls between microservices, grouped by domain around a circle. Edge widths follow the call volume, edgeColor="source" tints each edge with its caller, and the tension bundles the edges through the center.

arc.title: Arc diagram
arc.description: Which programming languages influenced which: the nodes sit on a line ordered by family, and each influence is an arc above it. Hover a language to see its ancestors and descendants.

transitions.title: State machine: arrowheads, parallel edges and loops
transitions.description: Order states and the events between them. Several events join the same two states (in either direction): each gets its own curve. Events that keep the state are drawn as loops on the free side of their node. arrowStyle="filled" draws solid arrowheads in the edge color; they follow the theme and the highlight on every renderer.

vanilla.title: Core engine
vanilla.description: createGraphChart from minerva-design/charts/core, without React: switch the layout with setOptions, listen to click and layoutEnd events, and center a clicked node with focusNode.

service-map.title: Live service map
service-map.description: The services of an online store placed by hand with layout="none" (node x / y), so live updates never move them. Every 1.5 s a new sample recolors each service through its health group and updates the p95 latency in its subtitle; edgeColor="target" tints the calls into a failing service. Click a service to read its metrics.

knowledge-graph.title: Knowledge graph search
knowledge-graph.description: Physicists, places, institutions and ideas linked by named, directed relations. Type in the search box and pick a match: the selected prop and focusNode on the ref select it and center it, and the facts about it are listed with Intl.ListFormat.

friend-suggestions.title: People you may know
friend-suggestions.description: A social network in four circles. Click a person: friends of friends are ranked by mutual friends, and the person and the suggestions stay highlighted through the controlled selected prop; interaction={{ select: false }} leaves clicks to onItemClick.

fraud-ring.title: Fraud rings in a dark theme
fraud-ring.description: Accounts linked to the devices and cards they used; the node shape draws devices and cards as boxes. Click any node to select its whole cluster and rate its risk. The chart sits in a nested ConfigProvider and reads its dark or light theme when it is created.

GraphChartProps.layout: Placement of the nodes: force, circular, arc, dag, tree, radial, mindmap, org, or none (positions of the nodes)
GraphChartProps.direction: Flow direction of the dag and tree layouts: TB, LR, BT or RL
GraphChartProps.force: Settings of the force layout: link distance, charge, gravity, collisions, seed, worker
GraphChartProps.circular: Settings of the circular and arc layouts: node order and edge tension
GraphChartProps.dag: Settings of the layered layout (layout="dag"): gaps, sweeps, critical path
GraphChartProps.tree: Settings of the tree layouts: root, gaps, collapsing, card size

GraphCommonProps.nodes: The nodes: id, label, group, value, color, size, shape and optional position
GraphCommonProps.edges: The edges between node ids (parent → child in trees, prerequisite → dependent in DAGs); unknown ids are ignored
GraphCommonProps.groups: Groups of nodes: legend order, names and colors; groups only used by the nodes are added
GraphCommonProps.height: Height of the chart, the legend included; numbers are pixels
GraphCommonProps.width: Width of the chart; numbers are pixels
GraphCommonProps.nodeShape: Shape of the nodes without their own shape; boxes for DAGs, org charts and mind maps, circles otherwise
GraphCommonProps.nodeSize: Diameter of the circles in layout units, or a [min, max] range scaled by the node value
GraphCommonProps.edgeStyle: Shape of the edges: straight, curve, spline or orthogonal; depends on the layout when omitted
GraphCommonProps.edgeWidth: Edge width in pixels, or a [min, max] range scaled by the edge value
GraphCommonProps.edgeColor: Edge colors: neutral, or tinted with the color of the source or target node
GraphCommonProps.arrows: Arrowheads on the edges that do not set directed; on for DAGs
GraphCommonProps.arrowStyle: Shape of the arrowheads: open (a slim outlined head) or filled (a solid head in the edge color, following the theme and the highlight)
GraphCommonProps.nodeLabels: Node labels: always, never, or auto (minor and overlapping labels are hidden when zoomed out). Text inside boxes keeps a readable minimum size and is shortened with an ellipsis; it is hidden only when the box is too small for any text, or with false
GraphCommonProps.edgeLabels: Edge labels: always, auto (zoomed in or highlighted), only hover, or never
GraphCommonProps.highlight: What hovering or selecting a node highlights: its neighbors, its whole lineage (ancestors and descendants), or nothing
GraphCommonProps.selected: Ids of the selected nodes; changing the prop updates the selection
GraphCommonProps.animation: Animates layout and data changes (collapse, new data); a number is the duration in milliseconds
GraphCommonProps.fitPadding: Space around the graph when it is fitted in the view, in pixels
GraphCommonProps.controls: Shows the zoom in, zoom out and fit buttons
GraphCommonProps.legend: Legend of the groups (position, toggling); shown by default when there are several groups
GraphCommonProps.tooltip: Tooltip of the nodes and edges; false disables it, render replaces its content
GraphCommonProps.interaction: Pan, zoom, wheel mode, node dragging, selection and keyboard; false makes the chart static
GraphCommonProps.renderer: Backend of the nodes and edges: auto tries WebGPU, WebGL2, WebGL, then Canvas2D
GraphCommonProps.palette: Colors of the groups without color; defaults to the chart CSS variables, then the theme colors
GraphCommonProps.locale: Language of the built-in texts and numbers; defaults to the page language
GraphCommonProps.onHover: Called when the hovered or keyboard-focused node or edge changes (null when nothing is hovered)
GraphCommonProps.onItemClick: Called when a node or an edge is clicked, or a node activated with Enter
GraphCommonProps.onSelectionChange: Called with the ids of the selected nodes when the selection changes
GraphCommonProps.onToggle: Called when a tree node is collapsed or expanded
GraphCommonProps.onGroupToggle: Called when the legend shows or hides a group
GraphCommonProps.onLayoutEnd: Called when the layout is done (for the force layout: when the simulation has cooled down)
GraphCommonProps.onRendererChange: Called with the backend once it is ready, and again after a fallback
GraphCommonProps.ref: Imperative handle: fit, focusNode, select, expand / collapse, getPositions…

GraphChartHandle.fit: Fits the visible nodes in the view (animated by default)
GraphChartHandle.focusNode: Centers a node, expanding its collapsed ancestors, and optionally zooms
GraphChartHandle.setData: Replaces the nodes, edges and groups until the next render with new props
GraphChartHandle.select: Selects nodes by id; null clears the selection
GraphChartHandle.expand: Expands a tree node, or every node without an id
GraphChartHandle.collapse: Collapses a tree node, or every node with children without an id
GraphChartHandle.toggle: Collapses an expanded node or expands a collapsed one
GraphChartHandle.getPositions: Current positions of the nodes, in layout units
GraphChartHandle.relayout: Computes the layout again (restarts the force simulation)
GraphChartHandle.getRenderer: Backend in use, null until ready

GraphNode.id: Unique identifier, referenced by the edges
GraphNode.label: Text shown next to or inside the node; the id when omitted
GraphNode.subtitle: Second line of boxes and org chart cards (job title, version, status)
GraphNode.group: Group id: color and legend entry
GraphNode.value: Weight of the node: sizes the circles and ranks the labels; the duration of a task for the critical path
GraphNode.color: Color of the node (any CSS color, var(--x) included); wins over the group color
GraphNode.size: Diameter of a circle or height of a box, in layout units
GraphNode.shape: Circle or box; the nodeShape option when omitted
GraphNode.x: Horizontal position (layout none, initial position of the force layout)
GraphNode.y: Vertical position (layout none, initial position of the force layout)
GraphNode.fixed: The force layout keeps the node at its x / y
GraphNode.collapsed: Tree layouts: the children of the node start hidden
GraphNode.data: Any data, passed back in the events

GraphEdge.value: Weight of the edge: line width and link strength of the force layout
GraphEdge.label: Text drawn on the edge (name of the relationship)
GraphEdge.directed: Draws an arrowhead at the target; the arrows option when omitted
GraphEdge.width: Line width in pixels; derived from the value when omitted
GraphEdge.data: Any data, passed back in the events

GraphGroup.id: Id referenced by the group of the nodes
GraphGroup.name: Name shown in the legend and the tooltip; the id when omitted
GraphGroup.color: Color of the nodes of the group; the palette when omitted
GraphGroup.hidden: Starts hidden (the legend can show it)

GraphForceOptions.linkDistance: Rest length of the edges, between the node borders, in layout units
GraphForceOptions.linkStrength: Stiffness of the edges from 0 to 1; 1 / smallest degree of the two ends when omitted
GraphForceOptions.charge: Many-body strength; negative values push the nodes apart
GraphForceOptions.theta: Barnes–Hut accuracy: larger values are faster and less accurate
GraphForceOptions.gravity: Pull of every node towards the center, which keeps disconnected parts together
GraphForceOptions.collide: Prevents overlapping nodes; a number adds spacing in layout units
GraphForceOptions.velocityDecay: Damping of the velocities at every tick, from 0 to 1
GraphForceOptions.iterations: Number of ticks of a full cooling
GraphForceOptions.seed: Seed of the random jitter: the same data always gives the same layout
GraphForceOptions.worker: Runs the simulation in a Web Worker: auto above 2,000 nodes; falls back to the main thread
GraphForceOptions.animate: Shows the simulation while it runs; false shows only the result
GraphForceOptions.multilevel: Multilevel start of large graphs (400+ nodes without positions): a coarsened graph is laid out first, then refined; several times faster than a full cooling. false always runs the full cooling

GraphCircularOptions.order: Order of the nodes: by group, by degree, or the data order
GraphCircularOptions.tension: Pull of the circular edges towards the center, from 0 (straight chords) to 1

GraphInteractionOptions.pan: Dragging the background pans the view
GraphInteractionOptions.wheel: Wheel zoom only with Ctrl / ⌘ (a hint explains it) or always
GraphInteractionOptions.drag: Nodes can be dragged; on by default for the force, circular and free layouts
GraphInteractionOptions.select: Clicking selects nodes (Ctrl / ⌘ + click adds); multiple adds without a modifier
GraphInteractionOptions.keyboard: Arrow keys move between nodes, Enter selects or expands, + / - zoom, 0 fits, Esc clears

GraphLegendOptions.position: Legend above or below the chart

GraphTooltipOptions.render: Renders the tooltip content of a node or an edge: a string, a DOM node, or null to hide it

GraphForceSimulation.reheat: Restarts the cooling from a temperature (0.3 by default)
GraphForceSimulation.drag: Pins a node at a position and keeps the simulation warm
GraphForceSimulation.release: Releases a dragged node, or keeps it pinned
GraphForceSimulation.done: Whether the simulation has cooled down
GraphForceSimulation.settle: Pushes overlapping nodes apart; run it after the last tick

routes.title: Air routes between hubs
routes.description: A force-directed network of hub cities: node size from the size of the hub, edge width from the weekly flights, colors by region; names follow the page language.

circular.title: Circular layout and selection
circular.description: The same routes on a circle grouped by region, edges tinted with the color of their source; clicking cities (Ctrl / ⌘ + click to add) reports the selection.

props.options: Other engine options (GraphChartOptions: force, circular, dag, tree, nodeSize, edgeWidth, arrows, nodeLabels, edgeLabels, animation, legend, tooltip, interaction, renderer, palette, ariaLabel, labels…); property only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected

events.minerva-hover: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) node / edge changed; detail: { type, id, node, edge, index, group, color, degree, clientX, clientY }, null when nothing is hovered
events.minerva-item-click: A node or an edge was clicked (or a node activated with Enter); detail: { type, id, node, edge, index, group, color, degree, clientX, clientY }
events.minerva-toggle: A tree node was collapsed or expanded; detail: { id, collapsed }
events.minerva-group-toggle: The legend showed / hid a group; detail: { group, hidden }
events.minerva-layout-end: The layout is done (the force simulation cooled down); detail: { layout }
events.minerva-renderer-change: The backend is ready, or fell back after a GPU loss; detail: { renderer }

methods.fit: Fits the visible nodes in the view
methods.focusNode: Centers a node (expanding its collapsed ancestors), optionally zooming
methods.setData: Replaces the data until the properties change again
methods.expand: Expands a node (all nodes without an id)
methods.collapse: Collapses a node (all nodes with children without an id)
methods.getPositions: Current positions of the nodes in layout units
methods.getRenderer: Backend in use (webgpu, webgl2, webgl, canvas2d), null until ready
